about: Which card-value files the website shows and the golden cases of its simulation panel are built from (ADR-046). A file in this directory is measured data; being listed here is the decision to show it. One set per class. 'test' names the comparison that tested a set when that is not the default one (rules_v2 against rules_v1, ADR-031 and ADR-034), and what the tested pilot was compared with.
